name: pc-memory
description: Surfaces memory at session start: the user sees one summary line per directory level and its stale notes, then a reminder to run `reconcile` when a review is due, the model gets the parent levels' indexes only, capped and marked as data. Asks the user before any write into a memory directory, counts per note the sessions that read it, and its `reconcile` skill reviews the notes with the user and applies the approved plan.
